task.prompt: A traveler flies SQ306 from Singapore (SIN) to London Heathrow (LHR), connects, then flies BA117 from LHR to New York (JFK), all on 10 June 2025. Scheduled times: SQ306 departs SIN 09:00 SGT, arrives LHR 15:40 BST; BA117 departs LHR 17:55 BST, arrives JFK 20:45 EDT. What is the total elapsed journey time from SIN departure to JFK arrival?

outcome.answer: The total elapsed journey time is about 11 hours 45 minutes (6h40m SIN-LHR, 2h15m connection, 2h50m LHR-JFK).

steps.name: plan
steps.input: 1) Work out the duration of each flight leg and the layover from the scheduled times. 2) Sum them. 3) Sanity-check the total against the end-to-end departure/arrival difference. 4) Answer.
steps.output: Plan set. Working through the legs in order.

steps.name: calculator
steps.note: Divergence: used a plain calculator on local clock times. SGT/BST/EDT offsets are ignored, so every leg duration is wrong.

steps.name: calculator

steps.name: reason
steps.output: Leg-by-leg gives 11h45m and door-to-door (20:45 minus 09:00) also gives 11h45m — the two methods agree, so the total holds.
steps.note: Failed sanity check: SIN to New York via London in under 12 hours should have triggered a re-check of timezone handling.
